strategy_roster.name: Omega Galsky
strategy_roster.notes: The documented EMA(8/21/89) crossover and price confirmation are exact. Decimal SlPercentage=0.001 and TpPercentage=0.0025 are represented as 0.1% and 0.25%; break-even and intraday timing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Color JFATL Digit Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: A positive EMA(20) slope above price is an explicit bullish JFATL-color proxy; EMA(20) is a fallback because no period is documented. FATL/Jurik color codes, applied-price and digit controls, and unsupplied point protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: VininI Trend LRMA
strategy_roster.notes: Z-score(13) replaces the unavailable linear-regression moving average, with zero substituting the instrument-specific +10/-10 breakdown levels. The Twist mode, 4-hour timeframe, and opposite-signal exit are approximated; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Keltner Channel Golden Cross
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,20) + 2 * atr(high,low,close,14) and ema(close,20) > ema(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: Keltner is approximated by EMA(20) plus/minus 2 ATR(14), and EMA(20)>EMA(50) is the golden-cross confirmation; all lengths are fallbacks because none are documented. ATR-based stop and target cannot be encoded as fixed percentages.

strategy_roster.name: Color Schaff JJRSX MMRec Duplex
strategy_roster.notes: MACD(12,26,9) histogram zero crosses are a fallback proxy for the unavailable Schaff/JJRSX cycle; no source periods are supplied. JJRSX smoothing, historical signal bars, and loss-count money-management scaling cannot be represented in the stateless long-only DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Intraday Volume Swings
strategy_roster.notes: A volume-confirmed close above the prior five-bar high proxies entry into the current/previous high swing region. The daily-region definition, RegionMustClose clock semantics, and opposite short region are unavailable; 1.2 is an explicit volume threshold fallback.

strategy_roster.name: Hoop Master
strategy_roster.notes: A close above the prior two-bar high with above-average volume is a stateless breakout-order proxy. Pending-order recycling, doubling/martingale size, pip indentation, and unspecified stop/target/trailing distances are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Fisher CG Oscillator
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(9) crossing its EMA(3) is an explicit bounded-oscillator/trigger-line proxy for Fisher CG; these lengths are fallbacks because none are supplied. Fisher transformation, SignalBar, position sizing, and unsupplied price-step protection are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: AK-47 Scalper
strategy_roster.notes: The source manages a short sell-stop only, so no long entry is fabricated in this long-direction catalog. Spread, clock, portfolio sizing, pending-order updates, and pip-based protection require unsupported quote/time/order-state features.

strategy_roster.name: Kloss MQL/8186
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(14)<40 with a bullish close proxies the oversold CCI/Stochastic and shifted-price reversal; the oscillator thresholds are normalized fallbacks. Exact CCI, Stochastic, five-bar shift, and 48/152-point protection are unavailable.
